lessons.title: 语法 · Grammar
lessons.html:
语法 · Grammar

Results

say what result an action had (finished, understood, seen, got it wrong, mastered) with result complements, and talk about study and homework.

  1. Verb + result: 完 (finished), 好 (done properly, ready), 懂 (understood), 见 (perceived), 到 (reached, achieved), 错 (wrongly), 会 (mastered), 住 (fixed firmly), 干净 (clean).
  2. 了 goes after the result: 我做完了。我看见他了。
  3. Negate with 没, drop 了: 我没听懂。他没做完。
  4. Questions: 你听懂了吗？ / 你听懂没有？
  5. 看 vs 看见: 看 is the action (look); 看见 is the result (actually see). Same for 听 / 听见.

Practice activities

  • Role-play: homework help. The app is a classmate stuck on 5 questions. Ask whether they understood, point out what they wrote wrong, and check the answers together.
  • Result builder: Drag a verb tile (看, 听, 做, 写, 学, 记) and a result tile (见, 懂, 完, 错, 会, 住) together to match 10 English prompts against a timer.
  • Look vs see: The app reads 8 situations; choose 看 or 看见, 听 or 听见.
  • Clean-up report: After tidying a room, handwrite 5 sentences about the results: 房间打扫干净了。书放好了。
  • Odd one out: 看见 / 听见 / 遇到 / 房间 · 正确 / 错误 / 干净 / 词典 · 复习 / 预习 / 检查 / 黑板
  • Story chain starter: 昨天的考试，我有一道题没看懂……

lessons.title: 语法 · Grammar
lessons.html:
语法 · Grammar

Movement

describe movement toward or away from you with 来 and 去, and in any direction (up, down, in, out, back, over, up from sitting) with direction complements.

  1. Verb + 来 / 去: 来 means toward the speaker, 去 away. Upstairs calling down: 你上来吧！ Answering from downstairs: 我马上上去。
  2. Compound direction: verb + 上 / 下 / 进 / 出 / 回 / 过 / 起 + 来 / 去: 走进来，跑出去，拿回来，站起来。
  3. A place goes between the verb and 来 / 去: 进教室来，回家去，上楼来。 Never 回去家.
  4. A thing can go before or after 来 / 去: 拿一本书来 = 拿来一本书。
  5. 起来 = up from lying or sitting: 站起来。 掉下来 / 掉下去 = fall down (toward or away from you).

Practice activities

  • Role-play: moving day. Direct a mover (the app) where everything goes: 搬进来，拿上去，放在门口. The app asks back when it's unclear.
  • Where's the speaker? The app shows a picture with a speaker marked; choose 来 or 去 for 10 sentences.
  • Simon says: The app calls 站起来，坐下，走过来，走过去，跳起来 faster and faster; do each, then write all five.
  • Place slot: Rewrite 6 sentences, moving the place word into the right slot (回去 + 家 → 回家去).
  • Odd one out: 箱子 / 盒子 / 书包 / 电梯 · 上来 / 下去 / 起来 / 楼下 (楼下 is a place) · 里面 / 外面 / 门口 / 取
  • Story chain starter: 我开门走进来，看见……

lessons.title: 语法 · Grammar
lessons.html:
语法 · Grammar

Can or can't

say whether something can or can't be done (understood, seen, finished, found) with potential complements, and handle problems at the table and on the clock.

  1. Verb + 得 + result = can; verb + 不 + result = can't: 听得懂 / 听不懂，看得见 / 看不见，吃得完 / 吃不完，找得到 / 找不到。
  2. Works with directions too: 上得去 / 上不去，回得来 / 回不来。
  3. 来得及 / 来不及 = there's time / there isn't.
  4. Verb + 不了 = can't (at all, or can't manage that amount): 吃不了，去不了。
  5. Questions: 你听得懂吗？ or 你听得懂听不懂？
  6. Prefer these over 能: say 我听不懂, not 我不能听懂.

Practice activities

  • Role-play: restaurant. Ask the waiter (the app) whether dishes are spicy, sweet or salty, whether two people can finish them, and ask for chopsticks or a spoon.
  • Can or can't? The app describes 10 situations (the print is tiny, the room is noisy, there's too much food); respond each time with the right potential complement.
  • Taste test: Name 6 foods you know and describe each with 甜, 咸, 辣 and whether you 吃得了.
  • Clock race: The app gives a start time, a travel time and a deadline; say 来得及 or 来不及 and why.
  • Odd one out: 辣 / 甜 / 咸 / 碗 · 筷子 / 勺子 / 碗 / 菜单 (菜单 isn't for eating with) · 担心 / 着急 / 害怕 / 座位
  • Story chain starter: 我第一次用筷子，可是……

lessons.title: 语法 · Grammar
lessons.html:
语法 · Grammar

Doing things to things (把)

say what you did to a specific thing and where it ended up, using 把, while talking about chores and belongings.

  1. Subject + 把 + object + verb + something more: 我把作业做完了。 The object is a specific, known thing.
  2. The verb can't stand alone. It needs a result, a direction, a place or 了: 把书放在桌子上。把门关上。 Never 我把书看.
  3. Common endings: 把…放在 (put at), 把…送到 (deliver to), 把…借给 (lend to), 把…翻译成 / 换成 (turn into).
  4. Negatives and modals go before 把: 我没把作业带来。别把手机忘了。
  5. Why use it: 把 focuses on what happened to the thing. It's how Chinese gives instructions about objects.

Practice activities

  • Role-play: messy roommate. The app reports 6 messes (socks on the floor, dirty plates…); give an instruction for each with 把.
  • Room makeover: The app shows a room and a set of items; drag each item to a spot and narrate it: 我把画儿挂在墙上。
  • 把 converter: Rewrite 8 ordinary sentences as 把 sentences (我做完了作业 → 我把作业做完了).
  • Broken 把: The app shows 把 sentences with a bare verb; add the missing ending to fix each one.

lessons.title: 语法 · Grammar
lessons.html:
语法 · Grammar

Things done to you (被)

describe things that happened to you or your belongings with 被, especially bad luck, and report a problem.

  1. Receiver + 被 + (doer) + verb + something more: 我的自行车被偷了。我被老师批评了。
  2. The doer can be left out: 被（人）偷了。
  3. The verb needs an ending, just like 把: 了, a result or a direction. Never 我的车被偷.
  4. Negatives go before 被: 我没被批评。
  5. In speech 被 usually marks something bad or unexpected, but good news works too: 她被老师表扬了。
  6. Spoken alternatives: 叫 or 让 can replace 被 when the doer is named: 钱包让小偷偷了。

Practice activities

  • Role-play: police report. Tell the officer (the app) what was stolen, when and where you noticed, and what it looks like. The app asks follow-up questions.
  • Worst day ever: The app shows 6 mishap pictures (spilled coffee, a broken cup, a dog bite…); describe each with 被.
  • Flip it: Turn 8 active sentences into 被 sentences (小偷偷了我的钱包 → 我的钱包被小偷偷了).
  • Good news too: Write 3 被 sentences about good things (被表扬, 被选为…).
  • Odd one out: 狗 / 猫 / 小偷 / 花瓶 (花瓶 isn't alive) · 批评 / 表扬 / 通知 / 脏 · 偷 / 骗 / 咬 / 运气
  • Character detective: 狗 and 猫 carry 犭 (animal); 破 and 碰 carry 石 (stone: things that break against stone).
  • Story chain starter: 今天真倒霉，早上我被……

lessons.title: 语法 · Grammar
lessons.html:
语法 · Grammar

Ongoing states (着)

describe scenes and states (a door is open, someone is wearing something, a map hangs on the wall) with 着, and tell 着 apart from 在.

  1. Verb + 着 = an ongoing state: 门开着。他穿着红衣服。
  2. Describing a scene: place + verb + 着 + thing: 墙上挂着一张地图。桌子上放着一本书。草地上躺着很多人。
  3. Verb₁ + 着 + verb₂ = do verb₂ in the manner of verb₁: 她笑着说。我们走着去吧。
  4. Negative: 没 + verb + 着: 灯没开着。
  5. 在 vs 着: 在 is the action in progress (他在穿衣服, he's putting clothes on); 着 is the state that results (他穿着衣服, he has clothes on).

Practice activities

  • Role-play: describe and draw. Describe a photo to a friend (the app) over the phone using place + verb + 着 sentences; the app draws it and asks questions where it's unclear.
  • Scene writer: The app shows a park, a classroom or a bedroom; write 6 sentences about what is where (……上放着 / 挂着 / 站着……).
  • 在 or 着? The app shows 8 pairs of pictures (putting on a coat vs wearing one); choose 在 or 着 for each.
  • Act it out: The app calls 站着, 坐着, 躺着, 笑着说, 走着去; act each and say what you're doing.
  • Odd one out: 树 / 草 / 花 / 船 · 躺 / 站 / 笑 / 公园 · 阳光 / 鸟 / 河 / 热闹 (热闹 is an adjective)
  • Story chain starter: 我走进房间，看见桌子上放着……

lessons.title: 语法 · Grammar
lessons.html:
语法 · Grammar

Sequence

put actions in order (first, next, finally, before, after, as soon as), explain a process step by step, and talk about cooking.

  1. 首先…接着…最后… for steps; in speech also 先…然后 / 再…最后…
  2. Event + 之前 / 之后 (more formal than 以前 / 以后): 吃饭之前要洗手。
  3. Event + 的时候 = when: 我小的时候…… / 做饭的时候……
  4. 一…就… = as soon as: 水一开就放鸡蛋。我一到家就给你打电话。
  5. 等到…再… = wait until … then: 等到油热了再放菜。
  6. 同时 = at the same time; 当时 = back then.

Practice activities

  • Role-play: cooking show. You're the chef; explain a dish to the audience (the app) step by step with 首先, 接着, 最后. The app asks 然后呢？ whenever you pause.
  • Recipe shuffle: The app shows 6 recipe steps in random order; drag them into order and read them aloud with connectors.
  • As soon as: Join 8 pairs of actions with 一…就… (下课 / 去吃饭 → 一下课就去吃饭).
  • My morning, in order: Handwrite your morning routine with at least five sequence words.
  • Odd one out: 炒 / 煮 / 烤 / 锅 (锅 isn't a cooking method) · 盐 / 糖 / 油 / 刀 · 首先 / 接着 / 最后 / 厨房
  • Character detective: 炒 and 烤 carry fire 火 on the left; 煮 and 熟 carry fire dots 灬 at the bottom.
  • Story chain starter: 我第一次做饭的时候，首先……

lessons.title: 语法 · Grammar
lessons.html:
语法 · Grammar

Conditions

talk about conditions and consequences (if, as long as, only if, unless, no matter) and make plans that depend on something else.

  1. 如果 / 要是…（的话），就… = if … then: 要是明天下雨的话，活动就取消。
  2. 只要…就… = as long as (an easy condition is enough): 只要你坚持，就一定能学好。
  3. 只有…才… = only if (nothing else works): 只有多练习，才能说得流利。 Pairs with 才, never 就.
  4. 不管…都… = no matter what: 不管多忙，我都每天学汉语。 Needs a question word or an A-or-B choice after 不管.
  5. …，否则… = or else: 快点儿走，否则来不及了。

Words from earlier units

计划jìhuàplan
机会jīhuìopportunity
带dàibring, carry

Practice activities

  • Role-play: planning an outing. Plan a weekend trip with a friend (the app) whose plans keep changing; use 如果, 只要, 只有, 不管 and 否则 to agree on a plan B.
  • Pick the pair: The app gives a first half (只要… / 只有… / 不管…); drag in the matching 就, 才 or 都.
  • Life rules: Handwrite 5 personal rules: 不管……，我都…… / 只有……，才……。
  • Or else: Finish 6 warnings with 否则 (多穿点儿衣服，否则……).
  • Odd one out: 只要 / 只有 / 不管 / 伞 (伞 isn't a connector) · 同意 / 反对 / 决定 / 安全 · 取消 / 推迟 / 放弃 / 机会
  • Story chain starter: 要是我有一百万块钱的话，我就……

lessons.title: 语法 · Grammar
lessons.html:
语法 · Grammar

Contrast

contrast two ideas (although … but, however, yet, actually), compare city and country life, and weigh pros and cons.

  1. 虽然…，但是 / 可是… = although … (Chinese keeps both halves): 虽然很贵，但是很好。
  2. 不过 = however, a softer 但是: 农村环境好，不过工资低。
  3. 却 = yet. It's an adverb, so it goes after the subject of the second clause: 他虽然很忙，却每天锻炼。
  4. 其实 = actually (contrary to what you'd think): 大家都说难，其实不难。
  5. 本来 = originally (but then it changed); 原来 = so that's why / it turns out: 我本来想去，可是太忙了。原来你是北京人！

Practice activities

  • Role-play: city or countryside? Debate with the app: it argues for one, you argue for the other. Every reply must use 虽然…但是, 不过, 却 or 其实.
  • Pros and cons chart: Handwrite a table of 优点 and 缺点 for your own city, then join pairs into 虽然…但是 sentences.
  • Myth buster: The app states 6 common beliefs; correct each with 其实 (大家都说汉字很难，其实……).
  • 本来 or 原来? Choose the right word for 8 mini-stories.
  • Odd one out: 虽然 / 不过 / 却 / 空气 · 优点 / 缺点 / 区别 / 挤 · 房租 / 工资 / 压力 / 新鲜 (新鲜 is an adjective)
  • Story chain starter: 我本来想……，可是……

lessons.html:
语法 · Grammar

Adding on

add information (not only … but also, besides, in addition, even), say what interests you, and talk about hobbies, clubs and culture.

  1. 不但…，而且… = not only … but also. With one subject, put it before 不但: 他不但会说汉语，而且会写书法。
  2. 除了…（以外），还 / 也… = besides (adding): 除了书法以外，我还学吉他。
  3. 除了…（以外），都… = except (excluding): 除了他以外，我们都去了。 The second clause decides the meaning.
  4. 另外 = in addition (starts a new point); 甚至 = even (adds something surprising): 他甚至会唱京剧。
  5. 对…感兴趣 = be interested in: 我对中国历史很感兴趣。 Never 我感兴趣中国历史.

Practice activities

  • Role-play: club fair. Visit three club booths (the app plays each recruiter). Ask what each club does, then explain which you'll join with 不但…而且 and 除了…还.
  • Besides or except? The app gives 8 除了 sentences; decide whether each adds (还 / 也) or excludes (都), then complete it.
  • Brag sheet: Handwrite 5 sentences about a friend's talents with 不但…而且… and 甚至.
  • Interest survey: Ask 5 app characters 你对什么感兴趣？ and record the answers.
  • Odd one out: 书法 / 京剧 / 吉他 / 会员 (会员 isn't an art or instrument) · 不但 / 而且 / 另外 / 历史 · 演出 / 节目 / 音乐会 / 了解
  • Story chain starter: 我的朋友不但……，而且……

lessons.title: 语法 · Grammar
lessons.html:
语法 · Grammar

Emphasis (是…的, 连…都)

ask and tell the details of past events (when, where, how, with whom) with 是…的, stress extremes with 连…都 / 也, and talk about your life story.

  1. 是 + detail + verb + 的 asks about or stresses the when, where, how or who of something already done: 你是什么时候来的？我是坐飞机来的。
  2. 是 can be dropped in a positive sentence, but not in a negative one: 我去年来的。我不是一个人来的。
  3. An object can go before or after 的: 我是在北京学的汉语。 = 我是在北京学汉语的。
  4. 连…都 / 也 = even: 他连一个字都不认识。连孩子都知道。
  5. 一 + measure word + noun + 也 / 都 + 不 / 没 = not a single one: 我一次也没去过。
  6. 根本 + 不 / 没 = not at all: 我根本不认识他。

Practice activities

  • Role-play: the interview. The app is a 记者 doing a 采访 on your life. Answer every question with a 是…的 sentence (when, where, how, with whom), then interview the reporter back.
  • Detective: The app states 6 past events (王明去了上海); ask three 是…的 questions about each.
  • Exaggeration game: Finish 8 sentences with 连…都 (他太累了，连……都……).
  • Life timeline: Draw your timeline from 出生 to now; write a 是…的 sentence for each milestone.
  • Odd one out: 小学 / 中学 / 大学 / 专业 · 记者 / 新闻 / 消息 / 飞 · 航班 / 晚点 / 到达 / 老家
  • Story chain starter: 我是在……出生的。小时候……

语法 · Grammar

Softening and vividness (reduplication)

soften requests and suggestions with verb reduplication (看看, 商量商量, 想了想), make descriptions vivid with reduplicated adjectives (红红的, 干干净净), and talk about relaxing at the weekend.

  1. One-syllable verb: AA or A一A = do it a little, try it: 你尝尝。我看一看。

lessons.title: 语法 · Grammar
lessons.html:
语法 · Grammar

Frequency and timing

say how often and how long things happen (always, all along, never, occasionally), say whether something happened early or late with 就 and 才, and talk about schedules, punctuality and the seasons.

  1. 总是 = always (a habit); 一直 = without a break, all along: 他总是迟到。雨一直下了三天。
  2. 从来 + 不 = never (as a habit); 从来 + 没(有) + verb + 过 = never once: 我从来不喝咖啡。我从来没去过上海。
  3. 就 = sooner or earlier than expected, usually with 了; 才 = later than expected, never with 了: 他七点就来了。他九点才来。
  4. 刚 + verb = have just done; 刚才 is a time word and can go before the subject: 我刚到。刚才他来了。
  5. 终于 = finally, after a wait or effort: 等了一个小时，车终于来了。
  6. 按时 = on schedule; 准时 = punctual; 及时 = in time: 请按时吃药。他总是很准时。医生来得很及时。

Practice activities

  • Role-play: late again. The app is your boss. Explain why you were late with 才, 刚 and 一直, then promise to be 准时.
  • Early or late? The app shows 10 timetables and what really happened; say each one with 就 or 才.
  • Never ever: Say 6 things you 从来不 do and 4 places you 从来没去过.
  • Habit survey: Ask the app how often it does 8 things; it answers with 总是 / 平时 / 有时候 / 偶尔 / 从来不, and you report back.
  • Odd one out: 春 / 夏 / 秋 / 刻 · 准时 / 按时 / 及时 / 偶尔 · 秒 / 刻 / 半夜 / 记得
  • Story chain starter: 那天我的闹钟没响，……

lessons.title: 语法 · Grammar
lessons.html:
语法 · Grammar

Approximation and amounts

give rough numbers (about, more than, two or three, at least, at most), talk about prices, weights and distances, and use percentages and doubling.

  1. Number + measure word + 左右 = about (左右 goes after): 他三十岁左右。五点左右见。
  2. 大约 / 大概 + number = approximately (goes before): 大约来了五十个人。
  3. 多 = more than. Round number (10, 20, 100) + 多 + measure word; 1–9 + measure word + 多: 十多个人。一个多小时。
  4. Two neighbouring numbers = a rough guess: 两三个、七八天、三四十个人。
  5. 至少 = at least; 最多 = at most: 至少要三天。最多二十个人。
  6. 百分之 + number = percent; 增加了一倍 = doubled: 百分之三十的人同意。价格增加了一倍。

Words from earlier units

差不多chàbudūonearly, about the same
米mǐmetre; rice

Practice activities

  • Role-play: at the market. The app is a fruit seller. Ask prices per 斤, bargain, and say roughly how much you want (两三斤, 一公斤左右).
  • Guess the number: The app describes 8 things (a teacher's age, a city's population); guess with 左右, 多 or 大约, and it tells you higher or lower.
  • Budget check: The app gives a trip budget and 6 costs; say whether it's 够, how much is 剩, and what percentage each cost is.
  • Double or half: Turn 8 before-and-after numbers into 增加了一倍 / 减少了一半 sentences.
  • Odd one out: 公斤 / 公里 / 米 / 价格 · 万 / 亿 / 百分之 / 零钱 · 增加 / 减少 / 超过 / 部分
  • Story chain starter: 我口袋里只剩十块钱了，……

lessons.title: 语法 · Grammar
lessons.html:
语法 · Grammar

Work and the office

talk about jobs and the office, say why you do something with 为了, say who had you do it with 让 / 叫, and give your view with 对…来说.

  1. 为了 + goal, (subject) + action = in order to: 为了学好汉语，他每天练习。
  2. 让 / 叫 + person + verb = have, make or tell someone do something: 经理让我加班。妈妈叫我早点儿回家。
  3. 对 + person + 来说 = for someone, in someone's view: 对我来说，工资不是最重要的。
  4. 关于 + topic = about; at the start of a sentence or before 的 + noun: 关于这个问题，我们明天再谈。关于工作的事。
  5. 只好 = have no choice but to; it goes after the subject: 电脑坏了，我只好用手写。
  6. 请假 is verb + object, so time goes in the middle: 我想请两天假。

Words from earlier units

工资gōngzīwages, salary
通知tōngzhīnotify; notice
机会jīhuìopportunity, chance

Practice activities

  • Role-play: the job interview. The app interviews you for a job. Talk about your 经验 and 能力 and say why you want the job with 为了.
  • Office orders: The app is a demanding boss; pass its 8 orders on to a colleague with 经理让你… / 经理叫你….
  • Leave request: Write a short 请假 email to your manager: why, how many days, and who will 负责 your work.
  • Priorities: Rank 工资, 机会, 同事 and 时间 and explain your order with 对我来说.
  • Odd one out: 打印 / 复印 / 邮件 / 辞职 · 经理 / 同事 / 客户 / 文件 · 加班 / 请假 / 面试 / 关于
  • Story chain starter: 星期一早上，经理叫我去他的办公室，……

语法 · Grammar

Body and change

name parts of the body, say what hurts and that you're ill, and describe change (more and more, the more … the more, become, start to).

  1. 越来越 + adjective = more and more (no 很 before the adjective): 天气越来越冷了。他越来越胖了。

  3. 变得 + adjective = become: 他变得很健康。
  4. Adjective + 起来 = start to become: 天气热起来了。他胖起来了。
  5. 了 at the end of a sentence marks a new situation: 你瘦了。我感冒了。
  6. Body part + 疼 = it hurts: 我头疼。他肚子疼。

lessons.title: 语法 · Grammar
lessons.html:
语法 · Grammar

Nature and environment

describe landscapes and what is where, compare places (much more, not as … as, just like), and talk about nature, weather and protecting the environment.

  1. Place + 有 + noun = there is; place + 是 + noun = what fills or stands at that place: 山上有很多树。山下是一个湖。
  2. 到处 + 都 = everywhere: 公园里到处都是人。
  3. A 像 B 一样 + adjective = A is as … as B (no 很): 湖水像天一样蓝。
  4. A 比 B + adjective + 多了 / 得多 = much more (never 很 after 比): 今天比昨天热多了。
  5. A 没有 B 那么 + adjective = A is not as … as B: 城市没有农村那么安静。
  6. 一点儿也不 / 都不 + adjective = not at all: 这儿的水一点儿也不干净。

环境huánjìngenvironment
垃圾lājīrubbish, trash
河hériver
鸟niǎobird
熊猫xióngmāopanda

lessons.title: 语法 · Grammar
lessons.html:
语法 · Grammar

Travel and culture

talk about travel plans and past trips (过, 打算), do two things at once with 一边…一边, recommend places with 值得 and 既…又, and talk about history, customs and culture.

  1. Verb + 过 = have done it before (an experience); negative 没 + verb + 过: 我去过长城。我还没去过博物馆。
  2. 一边 A 一边 B = do A while doing B: 他一边走路一边听音乐。
  3. 打算 + verb = plan to: 我明年打算去北京。
  4. 既 A 又 B = both A and B: 这个宾馆既便宜又干净。
  5. 值得 + verb = be worth doing: 这个博物馆很值得去。
  6. ……，尤其是 + noun = especially: 我喜欢水果，尤其是苹果。

Words from earlier units

护照hùzhàopassport
地图dìtúmap
历史lìshǐhistory
打算dǎsuanplan, intend
长城Chángchéngthe Great Wall

Practice activities

  • Role-play: at the travel agency. The app is an agent. Say where you 打算 go, ask about 签证, 门票 and hotels, then 订 the trip.
  • Travel twins: Ask the app 8 你去过…吗？ questions and compare your trips with 过 and 还没…过.
  • Multitasking: The app shows 6 pictures of people doing two things at once; describe each with 一边…一边.
  • Sell my city: Write a 6-sentence ad for your city with 值得, 既…又 and 尤其是.
  • Odd one out: 护照 / 签证 / 门票 / 历史 · 博物馆 / 宾馆 / 景点 / 照相 · 传统 / 风俗 / 文化 / 订
  • Story chain starter: 第一次出国旅游的时候，我……

lessons.title: 语法 · Grammar
lessons.html:
语法 · Grammar

Opinions

give and ask for opinions (认为, 看法, 意见), agree and disagree politely with reasons, make guesses (看来, 恐怕, 也许), and push back with 难道…吗 and 并不.

  1. 认为 + clause = think (a considered view; 觉得 is softer): 我认为这个办法不错。
  2. 看来 = it seems (a conclusion from what you see): 看来他今天不会来了。
  3. 恐怕 = I'm afraid, probably (a worried guess): 恐怕我们来不及了。
  4. 难道 … 吗？ = surely not? (a rhetorical challenge): 难道你不知道吗？
  5. 并 + 不 / 没(有) = actually not (corrects what someone thinks): 这个问题并不难。我并没有生气。
  6. 同意 / 反对 / 支持 + person or idea: 我同意你的看法。大家都支持他。

Words from earlier units

同意tóngyìagree
反对fǎnduìoppose, be against
结果jiéguǒresult
相信xiāngxìnbelieve, trust
正确zhèngquècorrect
错误cuòwùmistake; wrong
办法bànfǎway, solution

Practice activities

  • Role-play: the debate. The app takes one side on a topic (养宠物, working from home); you take the other, give 3 理由, then find one point you both agree on.
  • Agree or not? The app reads 10 statements; react to each with 我同意 / 我反对 / 也许 / 并不 and one reason.
  • Surely not! Turn 6 surprising statements into 难道…吗？ challenges.
  • Opinion poll: Ask 5 people (or the app) for their 看法 on one question; report the result with 认为 and 看来.
  • Odd one out: 同意 / 支持 / 相信 / 错误 · 理由 / 原因 / 结果 / 恐怕 · 当然 / 肯定 / 确实 / 讨论
  • Story chain starter: 开会的时候，大家的意见都不一样，……

lessons.title: 语法 · Grammar
lessons.html:
语法 · Grammar

Telling a story

tell a story in order (while, suddenly, so, later, in the end), reveal a surprise with 原来, and describe feelings such as fear, shock and being moved.

  1. 正在 / 正 + verb + 的时候 = just as, while (sets the scene): 我正在洗澡的时候，电话响了。
  2. 突然 / 忽然 = suddenly; verb + 起 + object + 来 = start doing: 天突然下起雨来了。
  3. 于是 = so, and then (an action that follows from the last one): 他没带伞，于是在商店里等雨停。
  4. 后来 = later on, for the past only; 以后 works for past and future: 后来我们成了好朋友。以后我会去北京。
  5. 原来 = so it turns out (a discovery): 原来是你啊！
  6. 结果 = and as a result, in the end (often something you didn't want): 路上车太多，结果我们都迟到了。

Words from earlier units

原来yuánláiit turns out; originally
最后zuìhòufinally, last
当时dāngshíat that time
遇到yùdàorun into, meet
帮忙bāngmánghelp, do a favour
害怕hàipàbe afraid
哭kūcry
结束jiéshùend, finish
小偷xiǎotōuthief
警察jǐngchápolice officer
安全ānquánsafe; safety

Practice activities

  • Role-play: the police report. The app is a 警察. Tell it what 发生 with 正在…的时候, 突然, 于是 and 后来, and answer its questions about the 经过.
  • Picture story: The app shows a 6-panel comic; tell it in order, using a different connector for each panel.
  • Twist ending: Finish 6 mini-stories with a 原来… surprise.
  • Diary: Write a 100-character 日记 about something that made you 吃惊 or 感动.
  • Odd one out: 害怕 / 吃惊 / 感动 / 结束 · 讲 / 哭 / 救 / 情况 · 突然 / 忽然 / 于是 / 安全
  • Story chain starter: 那天晚上，我正在看书的时候，忽然……
